tests/support/architecture_cases.hpp:cla.explanation: Plane has an explicit post-move contract: empty dimensions and empty owned storage. Generic move checkers treat calls other than empty() as invalid without modeling the custom contract; sanitizer/reference suites verify the actual lifetime and shape behavior.

AttachConsole is the Windows SDK operation that targets the child process for the real CTRL_BREAK test. Include-cleaner cannot attribute it through the required windows.h umbrella.

GetConsoleCP and AllocConsole are Windows SDK calls that establish a console for the native interrupt test on hosted CI. Include-cleaner cannot map them through windows.h; this line is test-only and failure is reported explicitly.

std::from_chars parses the explicit [first, end) byte range and never requires NUL termination. This test-only Windows PID parser supplies both pointers from one nonempty string_view; the heuristic mistakes the bounded overload for a C-string consumer.
